stop_condition:
Report HIGH only for: an ordering the comparison gets wrong; a reintroduction of numeric
coercion anywhere on the comparison path; a new ambiguity from the leading-zero decision; a
regression of refuse-on-ambiguity; a forgeable or over-broad quarantine override; or a
legitimate task deadlocked. MEDIUM/LOW otherwise. If there is no HIGH, say so plainly.

findings.evidence: The selector accepts any comment whose first line merely starts with `REVIEW-ARTIFACT-QUARANTINE v1 hash=<64 hex>`; it does not require the writer's `at <timestamp>: <reason>` grammar. Moreover, normalize_comments() at line 1538 discards author and all other metadata, while hand-typed comments and bd imports can bypass cmd_quarantine_artifact's reason guard. A matching prefix is then sufficient for is_quarantined() to skip the malformed candidate at lines 1999-2000.
findings.description: The quarantine override is forgeable and over-broad: the producer/importer of a malformed artifact can post or import a bare matching quarantine prefix, with no validated reason or distinguishable operator authority, and thereby suppress the mandatory refuse-on-malformed behavior. The claimed durable, actor-attributed operator decision is not evidence the gate actually checks.
